provenance: Goose port of flash_attn_ext_f16_process_tile, fattn-mma-f16.cuh L1190-1786, active CUDA branch (TURING/AMPERE MMA + CP_ASYNC_AVAILABLE). Loaders mirror flash_attn_ext_f16_load_tile L383-441 and flash_attn_ext_f16_load_mask L487-515 (use_cp_async=true branches) exactly as the supplied reviewed loaders-device.goose specialization. Tile element maps taken from the exact CUDA specializations in mma.cuh: tile<16,8,half2> L400-428, tile<16,16,float> L239-254, ldmatrix address math L852-882, swizzle L786-801. SOFTMAX_FTZ_THRESHOLD=-20.0f verified in fattn-common.cuh L11. No runtime acceptance is claimed; the parent owns the CUDA bridge, raw-primitive bindings, build, GPU parity gates and rollback.

fixed_config.hardware: CUDA Ada (Ampere-MMA path, cp.async available); all other architectures/configs deferred

entry.call_convention: Parent CUDA wrapper calls it once per block thread with the parameters below; grid/block indices are plain arguments, no C callbacks.

parameters.name: q_f2
parameters.sem: global byte address of the float2 Q plane for this (sequence, zt_Q); element i at p+4i

parameters.name: k_h2
parameters.sem: global byte address of the half2 K plane for this (sequence, z_KV)

parameters.name: v_h2
parameters.sem: global byte address of the half2 V plane (forwarded to iterate)

parameters.name: mask_h
parameters.sem: global byte address of the half mask plane incl. nb33*sequence offset; never null for ncols2=8 (native L1921-1922)

parameters.name: sinks_f
parameters.sem: global byte address of sinks+zt_Q floats, or 0 when sinks are absent (optional sinks)

parameters.name: dstk
parameters.sem: global byte address of the float2 output plane ((float2*)dst + (sequence*ne01.z*ne02+zt_Q)*(DV/2))

parameters.name: dstk_fixup
parameters.sem: global byte address of the float2 fixup buffer base

parameters.name: scale
parameters.sem: native scale, applied to Q during staging

parameters.name: slope
parameters.sem: native slope (1.0 for ncols2>1), forwarded to iterate

parameters.name: ne01z
parameters.sem: ne01.z, query row count of the current sequence group

parameters.name: ne02
parameters.sem: native ne02 (Q heads)

parameters.name: gqa_ratio
parameters.sem: ne02/ne12

parameters.name: stride_q1
parameters.sem: nb01/8, float2 elements

parameters.name: stride_q2
parameters.sem: nb02/8, float2 elements

parameters.name: stride_k
parameters.sem: nb11/4, half2 elements

parameters.name: stride_v
parameters.sem: nb21/4, half2 elements (forwarded to iterate)

parameters.name: stride_mask
parameters.sem: nb31/2, half elements

parameters.name: jt
parameters.sem: query tile start row

parameters.name: zt_gqa
parameters.sem: GQA sub-tile start head

parameters.name: kb0_start
parameters.sem: first KV batch (kb0_start<kb0_stop guaranteed by native caller L1907-1908)

parameters.name: kb0_stop
parameters.sem: end KV batch, already clamped by native caller with KV_max/sparse logic

parameters.name: ncols1
parameters.sem: 4 or 8

parameters.name: np
parameters.sem: 2 when ncols1==4 else 1

parameters.name: needs_fixup
parameters.sem: native template flag: block missing the beginning of a tile (kb0_start!=0)

parameters.name: is_fixup

parameters.name: bx
parameters.sem: blockIdx.x

parameters.name: gx

parameters.name: tx
parameters.sem: threadIdx.x (lane)

parameters.name: ty
parameters.sem: threadIdx.y (warp)

parameters.name: qregs
parameters.sem: per-thread POD byte pointer, 64 u32 = 256 B, Q_B register-tile storage

parameters.name: vkqregs
parameters.sem: per-thread POD byte pointer, 64 u32 = 256 B, VKQ_C register-tile storage

parameters.name: kmax
parameters.sem: per-thread POD byte pointer, 2 f32 = 8 B, KQ_max storage

parameters.name: rowsums
parameters.sem: per-thread POD byte pointer, 2 f32 = 8 B, KQ_rowsum storage

parameters.name: smem
parameters.sem: dynamic shared memory generic byte base, 33792 B

per_thread_pod_storage.contract: Wrapper allocates four storage-only per-thread stack buffers (qregs 256 B, vkqregs 256 B, kmax 8 B, rowsums 8 B) and passes their byte addresses. ALL initialization (VKQ zeroing, KQ_max=-FLT_MAX/2, rowsum=0), all reads/writes, and all lifetime/control execute in Goose via fg175p_ldu32/stu32/gload/gstore. The wrapper must not initialize or interpret these bytes.
per_thread_pod_storage.layout: qregs/vkqregs: 16 consecutive tile<16,8,half2> fragments, tile t at u32 words 4t..4t+3 in tile.x[l] order (l=0..3). kmax/rowsums: f32 elements 0,1 (= native KQ_max[cols_per_thread=2]).
per_thread_pod_storage.why_not_local_arrays: The rework feedback replaced the requested rawlocaladdress/gg_view/gg_slice route: no supplied example source demonstrates any local address-of or view intrinsic, and array-typed function parameters appear only in the host-dialect accepted-rms-row.goose. The parent-supplied POD pointers avoid inventing unsupported capabilities while keeping every layout and access explicit in Goose.

map.tile_Q: byte 0, ncols*132 half2 words (16896 B for ncols1=4, 33792 B for ncols1=8)
map.tile_K: byte 0, 32 rows x 128 half2 x 4 B = 16384 B (overlays tile_Q, Q_in_reg union, native L1250-1253)
map.tile_mask: byte 32768, half rows of (nbatch_fa+8)=40 half (80 B) per ncols1 query row

shared_memory.swizzle: K/V tile byte offset (i*512+k*16)^((i%8)<<4) = mma.cuh swizzle<512,char>; tile_mask is never swizzled; meta floats live in tile_Q row padding words 128/129 (float index jc*132+128).
shared_memory.barrier_schedule: Eight native barrier sites preserved: L1319 after Q staging, L1330 after Q ldmatrix (before K/V overwrite of the union), L1394-1396 after the kb0 loop (nstages>1 && 64>32), L1555-1557 swz pre-meta, L1563 after meta write, L1626 (np>1 only) before combined meta write-back, L1712 after VKQ staging, L1775-1777 (np>1 only, since nbatch_combine==DKQ/2). The first fg175m_iter call performs cp_async_wait_all+__syncthreads for the preload issued here (native iter L634-635).

raw_effects.isa: cp.async.cg.shared.global [dst],[src],16 with L2::64B hint; dst is the generic-space shared byte address (parent converts the address space), src raw global byte address; identical binding to loaders-device.goose
generic/global f32 load at byte p+4i (F32 global load primitive; Q rows, sinks, kmax/rowsums POD)

raw_effects.c_sig: void fg175p_gstore(uint64_t p, uint64_t i, float v)
raw_effects.isa: generic/global f32 store at p+4i (dstk/dstk_fixup float2 outputs are two f32 stores; no vector-store ABI is claimed)
generic u32 word load at p+4i (per-thread POD qregs/vkqregs)

raw_effects.c_sig: void fg175p_stu32(uint64_t p, uint64_t i, uint32_t v)
raw_effects.isa: generic u32 word store at p+4i
shared u32 word load at p+4i (VKQ combine readback)

raw_effects.c_sig: void fg175p_smst(uint64_t p, uint64_t i, uint32_t v)
raw_effects.isa: shared u32 word store at p+4i (Q staging and VKQ staging, one half2 per word)
shared f32 load at p+4i (meta slots; float and half2 share 4-byte granularity so float index == half2 word index)

raw_effects.c_sig: void fg175p_smstf(uint64_t p, uint64_t i, float v)
raw_effects.isa: shared f32 store at p+4i (KQ_cmr/KQ_cms/KQ_crs meta slots)
half2 x half2 multiply, IEEE round-to-nearest per half lane (__hmul2)
pack {cvt.rn.f16.f32(x), cvt.rn.f16.f32(y)} (make_half2 with native RN conversion)
ldmatrix.sync.aligned.m8n8.x4.b16 with raw shared byte address a (must be 16 B aligned; the Q tile addresses here are: 528*j0 + 32*(q0/8) + 528*(tx%16) + 16*(tx/16))

extern_iterate.implementation: Goose module of the sibling worker (function named iterate there); NOT the original C++ flash_attn_ext_f16_iter.
extern_iterate.required_semantics: Port of flash_attn_ext_f16_iter (fattn-mma-f16.cuh L574-1072) for this fixed config with oob_check=false, use_sparse=false, V_is_K_view=false, k_VKQ_0=kb0*32, k_VKQ_sup=32 (constexpr for the non-oob path L1374/1383), last_iter=last. Must: wait the cp.async preload issued by process_tile (cp_async_wait_all+__syncthreads at entry, L634-635); issue the V tile cp.async load (L636-637); compute KQ C tiles from qregs Q_B and tile_K with the mma.cuh CUDA A/B swap (L682), softcap-free; add slope*mask from tile_mask rows at smem+32768; softmax with FATTN_KQ_MAX_OFFSET=(3.0f*0.6931f) and per-column shfl reductions (offsets 2,1); update kmax/rowsums POD; convert KQ C to B via get_half2; wait V and preload next mask+K via cp.async when !last (L981-996); compute VKQ tiles into vkqregs via ldmatrix.trans from tile_V with swizzle. Same shared map and same raw-primitive family; its internal loads must reproduce the 16384 B row arithmetic (32 rows*128 half2*4 B).
extern_iterate.boundary_ownership: process_tile owns: Q staging, Q_B ldmatrix, initial mask/K preload, kb0 loop control, post-loop barrier, rowsum warp reduction, sinks, meta write/combine, VKQ staging, output/fixup. iterate owns everything inside one native iter call. Neither side calls the original C++ arithmetic.

tile_index_math.tile_16_8_half2: ne=4; get_i(l)=((l%2)*8)+tx/4; get_j(l)=((l/2)*4)+tx%4 (mma.cuh L405-407/420-422, CUDA I_MAJOR, physical warp 32)
tile_index_math.tile_16_16_float: ne=8; get_i(l)=(((l/2)%2)*8)+tx/4; get_j(l)=((l/4)*8)+((tx%4)*2)+(l%2) (mma.cuh L246-247/263-264); only get_i is used here (sinks jc)
tile_index_math.q_ldmatrix_word_offset: j0*132+k0+(tx%16)*132+(tx/16)*4 with j0=(ty/np)*16, k0=0..120 step 8 (native L857 int-word arithmetic)
tile_index_math.meta_slot: float index jc*132+128 (and +1) == half2 word jc*132+128 == ((float2*)tile_Q)[jc*66+64] (float and half2 share 4-byte granularity)

numerical_contract: KQ_max initialized to -FLT_MAX/2 with exact f32 bits: computed as 2^127-2^103 from exact power-of-two products/subtraction, equal to native -FLT_MAX/2.0f (0x7EFFFFFF negated); no bitcast primitive used or needed.
Q staging: h2mul(h2pack(tmp.x,tmp.y), h2pack(scale,scale)) == native scale_h2*make_half2(tmp.x,tmp.y); half conversions are round-to-nearest; zero rows store h2pack(0.0,0.0)==0x00000000.

Sinks FTZ: native bit-trick *((uint32_t*)&s)*=(diff>=-20.0f) is expressed as the exact select s=0.0f when diff<-20.0f (SOFTMAX_FTZ_THRESHOLD=-20.0f, fattn-common.cuh L11); expf inputs are non-positive so no NaN divergence is reachable.

Combine: dstk_val = sum_ip half2float(tile[row+ip*16])*cms(ip), then divided by meta rowsum when neither fixup flag is set; np==1 uses crs==1.0 and divides by KQ_rowsum_j; fmaxf2 matches fmaxf for all inputs reachable here (finite or NaN-in-first-arg); divide order and half2->f32 conversion are per native L1751-1764.
All global float2 outputs (dstk, dstk_fixup data and meta) are emitted as two exact f32 stores per element; no fused or reordered accumulation is introduced.
fltmax2 arithmetic is exact in both f32 and f64 evaluation (products/subtraction of representable powers of two), so literal parsing width cannot change the bits.
loop_structure_facts: Q staging granularity loop {32,16,8,4}: for DKQ/2=128 only stride_k=32 emits (128-128%(2*s)==128-128%s for s<=16), stride_jc=1, so each thread stages one jc=jc0+ty column and k=k0+tx over 4 passes; native break statically false for ncols=32|64 (documented, removed like loaders-device.goose).
Output stride loop {32,16,8,4}: identically only stride_k=32 emits for nbatch_combine=128; jc0_dst step=(nwarps/np)*1=4/np; native break statically false.
Combine k00 loop is a single iteration (DV/2=128==nbatch_combine).
kb0 loop: while kb0<kb0_stop-1 with last_iter=false, then one unconditional last_iter=true call (native L1349-1390, else-branch).
nmeta=1 for np=2 (np*cols_per_warp=32==warp_size); combine shuffles are the single offset=16 pair exchange (loop from np*cols_per_warp/2=16 down to cols_per_warp=16 with offset<32 guard).
Rowsum reduction offsets are exactly {2,1} (TURING+ cols_per_warp!=8 path L1400-1416).

Fixup guards: np==1 meta writes need thread_should_write (tx%4<2); np>1 combined meta writes need ty%np==0 and tx<cols_per_warp=16; VKQ/output work needs np==1||ty%np==0; sinks additionally need !is_fixup and sinks_f!=0.

Virtual array ABI (f32[:] parameters with x[i] indexing) exists only in accepted-rms-row.goose, a host/testbench dialect example from a different experiment with print()/local main arrays; no device-side virtual-array effect binding is demonstrated, so none is claimed.

A vectorized 8/16-byte global float2 load/store primitive is not claimed; float2 IO is two f32 accesses (permitted F32 global load/store primitive). cp.async is the only 16-byte raw memory effect.

Goose literal parsing width (f32 vs f64) is not documented in examples; the FLT_MAX/2 construction is exact under either width, but the parent reviewer should confirm codegen of the -20.0f select and h2pack rounding.
expf/cvt.rn/hmul2 instruction-level parity and any FMA-contraction differences in the combine accumulation are parent-owned GPU gate findings; this worker does not claim bit parity.
The runtime conditions kb0_start<kb0_stop and 16 B alignment of cp.async src/dst are native caller guarantees; process_tile does not re-validate them (mirrors native).
